answer: With a Hardware security key bound by attestation certificate with revocation on transfer, the account is only as strong as its binding: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The record keeps every ferrous visible, so anyone can audit the binding roll. From the garden to the canyon, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
